say:21:1524308013:0.text: Come on, why sound so bleak? It's a good thing the bugs are gone! I'd celebrate if I didn't have to harvest the crops.

say:22:1524308014:0.source_cn: 走吧！剩下的农活还有不少，咱俩得赶紧回去干活了。

say:23:1524308015:0.text: Oh, I completely lost track of time! Thanks for your help! Bye!
